notes: Narrow window: no button disappears any more - rows wrap to a second line (Account Info, Page Info, Mail Info, Device grid, top bar). Mouse access: the real mouse is kept busy, one click per browser in turn, never idle and never waiting; when you put your hand on the mouse the app lets go and takes it back ~2.5 s after you stop. Raising Max parallel windows (Treat) while a script runs now opens the extra window(s) at once. Small screens: the top buttons wrap to more rows, the tab names and the Device grid buttons move instead of hiding. Fixed: the app freezing (Not Responding) after adding proxies to many accounts, and the freeze while an update downloads. GPM: when its API is off at browser open the app starts the installed GPM and waits for it; accounts opened in GPM show GPM's real useragent in the Useragent column. Language switch reloads before calling it failed; Russian / Thai / Chinese screens recognised. Suspend review: final 'rule' page read as the end, greyed Continue gets its box ticked, Spanish/French video selfie, no restart before an upload ends. Passkey: Chinese/Russian buttons, clear reason when Facebook says the change can't be made now. Face photo: good photos no longer dropped by an age misread. Other languages: French ads-choice / cookie / "What happened" pages, Russian buttons; the "What happened - multiple sessions" notice is closed (it blocked Remember Password and the language switch); "Your profile is suspended" read as the appeal page; a submitted 2FA box is not typed into again. Bug reports: no false 'time wasted' and no page-navigation noise.
